'''Water Park''' was a location on the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tynna/Legends|Tynna]]. It was the site of several residences.<ref name="EssGuiPlaMoo" />

==Behind the scenes==
Water Park was pictured in the [[1998]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]'', which was written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and illustrated by [[Brandon McKinney]] and [[Scott Kolins]].<ref name="EssGuiPlaMoo" />
